change: Classifier model qwen2.5:7b chosen over gemma3:4b (first instructions, strict relevance: settlement as the central subject).
Daily collector from raw GKG 2.1 files starts: pre-filter, model classification, one history file per day.
Reprints grouped into stories (story_id) and removal-word review flag tightened.
Broad relevance, multiple topics and a separate removal question with stage.
Removal entry gate (G4): removal word plus housing word lets a headline into the funnel without the SLUMS theme, name or keyword.
Model also returns the most specific place in the headline (place field).
Experimental map geocodes the model's place offline with GeoNames (map-side change, not recorded per history line).
Daily denominator: summary records gkg_articles, every GKG article read (total, by feed, language and country).
